description: Traces the rebellion through The Clone Wars, Rebels, Andor, and Rogue One, examining clone autonomy, the Ghost crew’s found family, local solidarity on Ferrix and Ghorman, prison labor, clandestine organizing, and the transmission of the Death Star plans. Asks how resistance is built and what its successes do and do not justify.
